evidence: Eight user-supplied full-width screenshots of Honeysuckle Airbnb calendar (March–October 2027). The user confirms in-season prices already include the Airbnb service-fee adjustment; do not add an additional platform uplift.
caveats: Some calendar cells are obscured by existing Airbnb booking bars; month-wide rates are visible on unobscured days and the held August-to-September week.
Dates before March 20 and after October 1 are out of the 2027 holiday season regardless of displayed calendar pricing.
Host calendar nightly amounts are not independently verified net payout totals and may exclude other guest charges/discounts.
This is an observed rate benchmark, not a command to update production or staging booking rates.
